subject: Sunday swap instead?
text:
Hi there,

I was hoping to stop by next Saturday with some seedlings from the co-op, but the weather looks shaky. If that works better, we could meet Sunday afternoon instead and do the swap under the shelter near the library. That might be easier if your parents are still visiting, and it would let me bring the extra pots without worrying about a muddy driveway.

Let me know if Sunday suits you. I can also pick up the spare gloves you lent us last spring while I'm out. I'll text once we're heading over so you don't feel tied to the house all afternoon. We could really enjoy the loop trail afterward, too, if the rain stays away again.
